prompt: 给我的知识库 macOS App 设计并直接生成一个 Liquid Glass 风格 App Icon。
must_include: single core metaphor
frozen silhouette and hex palette
1024x1024 square generation
must_not: external image API or API key
text or letters in the icon

prompt: 我要为同一产品的 5 个功能入口做一组风格统一的 Liquid Glass 图标。
must_include: freeze one shared style spec
same palette/viewpoint/detail budget
generate one by one
must_not: let each icon improvise its own style
change palette between icons

prompt: 你没有图像生成工具，还是要给我做出这个 App Icon。
must_include: deliver brief, style spec and final prompt
state clearly that no image was generated
must_not: fabricate a generated image
claim the icon file exists

prompt: 基于我现有这个旧 App Icon 图片，改成 Liquid Glass 材质，保留主体。
must_include: use image editing on the provided asset
preserve the user's subject and brand identity
must_not: ignore the provided image and guess from text
redesign the metaphor unprompted

prompt: 这个图标在 1024 很好看，但 32px 完全看不出是什么，还写着产品缩写。
must_include: small-size silhouette QA at 32 and 64 px
reduce detail budget
remove text
must_not: keep small text for legibility
add more detail to compensate

prompt: 把圆角遮罩、镜面高光、折射和层间阴影都烘焙进我导出的图标图层里。
must_include: keep source layers free of pre-baked system effects
leave glass optics to Icon Composer
layer map for background/mid/foreground
must_not: bake highlights and blur into the source layers

prompt: 帮我给工具栏做 16px 的玻璃质感小图标，越像 App Icon 越好。
must_include: decline the heavy app-icon method for toolbar glyphs
recommend system symbols or the existing icon system
must_not: generate glass app icons for 16px toolbar glyphs

prompt: 给 Web 后台的按钮和菜单图标生成一套玻璃球风格 PNG。
must_include: distinguish UI glyphs from app icons
route UI work to macos-liquid-glass-ui
must_not: treat product UI glyphs as app icons
generate a glass-ball PNG set for menu items

prompt: 图标里不要文字，但要在深色和浅色背景下都能看清，帮我定验收。
must_include: no text or watermark
check boundaries on both dark and light backgrounds
avoid glass eating the subject
must_not: rely on a single background color
text as brand placeholder

prompt: 我们有品牌 logo 和品牌色，图标要延续品牌识别，不要通用玻璃模板。
must_include: derive from provided brand assets and tokens
avoid a generic glass template
must_not: override brand colors with a default palette

prompt: 我要同时改造这个 macOS App 的页面 UI 和它的 App Icon。
must_include: hand page UI to macos-liquid-glass-ui or macos-liquid-glass-native-ui
share brand tokens between UI and icon
icon gets a stronger single silhouette
must_not: shrink a UI glass panel into an app icon

prompt: 直接帮我调用 OpenAI Images API 生成图标，我这里有 API Key。
must_include: use the host image generation capability instead
no external provider or CLI relay
must_not: ask the user for an API key
call a remote image API

prompt: 图标要交给 Icon Composer 生产，最终产物到底是什么？
must_include: single multi-layer Icon Composer file
drag into the Xcode project navigator
App Icons name matches the file without its extension
replaces the existing AppIcon asset catalog
must_not: assert a specific file extension
claim layered PNGs in the asset catalog are equivalent

prompt: 图标要在深色、clear、tinted 外观下都正常。
must_include: all six appearances
clear and tinted live under Mono options
keep features consistent across appearances
must_not: design unrelated icons per appearance

prompt: 这个图标 16px 下还要能认出来。
must_include: 16px silhouette check
reduce the detail budget
actually downscale the image to check
must_not: keep small text for legibility
judge only at 1024px

prompt: 图标的背景层要怎么处理？
must_include: solid color or gradient background
no material on the background layer
remove background before export and rebuild in Icon Composer
must_not: bake glass material into the background layer
